description.value: A full-service commercial stop on the Alaska Highway (mile 422) sitting right on Reflection Lake in northern BC, with tent sites alongside RV hookups, a restaurant, laundromat, and fuel; open year-round though winter brings limited services and extreme cold.

address.value: Mile 422 Alaska Highway, Toad River, BC V0C 2X0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details. Primary evidence comes from toadriverlodge.com, which confirms year-round operation, a 23-site full-service RV park on Reflection Lake, an on-site restaurant, and a booking system. Guest book entries confirm tent camping is accepted ('We put up our tent and stayed for 2 days') and mention 'wonderful clean bathrooms' and 'internet that works,' but neither showers nor device charging are explicitly confirmed for walk-in/cycle-in guests.
concerns: OSM fixme tag reads 'Needs survey' — on-the-ground verification of amenity details (showers, laundry, bike-specific facilities) is recommended.
Amenities page (/british-columbia-cabin-rental-rv-campground/) was truncated in the fetched content mid-sentence ('23-site full-service RV park with...'), so some amenity details may be missing.
OSM postal code is listed as 'VOC 2X0' (letter O) rather than the correct 'V0C 2X0' (zero) — minor data quality issue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, year-round, fully-serviced campground on the Alaska Highway in a very remote section of northern BC — exactly the kind of resupply and rest stop a touring cyclist would need and benefit from finding in a directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Tent camping is accepted based on guest book evidence ('We put up our tent and stayed for 2 days'). The lodge also has a gift shop and fuel stop based on a guest book entry ('I pulled into your outpost for fuel and breakfast'), which may be relevant to cycle tourists needing resupply.
